segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the sunscreen does not increase oiliness or greasiness and one notes no issues with an oily complexion throughout the day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-sensitive skin describe it as smoothing and non-drying, with no reported breakouts or irritation.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including sensitive-combo and acne-prone combo) skin report it feels light, non-greasy, and does not worsen oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often report no irritation, no burning, and comfortable all-day wear, though one sensitive-skin reviewer describes a breakout and hot, itchy skin near the ears.
segments.normal: One reviewer recommends the product for combo/normal and even oily skin, but there is little other specific normal-skin commentary.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions using it to help prevent wrinkles while protecting the skin, but mature skin is not otherwise discussed in detail.

concerns.aging: One reviewer says she wears it to help prevent wrinkles and protect her skin; another notes it softens the appearance of lines, but aging is not a frequently discussed concern.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the product as hydrating or leaving skin feeling hydrated, with no reports of it feeling drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a nose that burns easily reports no redness after wearing it; no other redness-specific reports appear.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation, stinging, or eye-watering, though one reviewer describes her skin turning hot and itchy after a few days of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with melasma reports it protected her skin well; another mentions the product slightly blurs brown spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report the sunscreen does not break them out, including several who say other sunscreens typically do; one reviewer describes a breakout near the ears after a few days of use.
concerns.oiliness: The majority of reviewers, including several with oily or combination skin, report the formula is non-greasy and does not increase oiliness, though one reviewer notes it made her makeup slightly more oily and needed extra setting powder.

extraits.texte: I REALLY wanted to like this due to the price but it was absolutely terrible. It flaked on my skin so bad. The first time I used it I used it on it's own and blended it with my fingers and it left flakey streaks on my face. So the second time I used my skincare first and tried to blend this in with a beauty blender and got the same results. Both times I shook the tube well according to the label and got the same results. Very sad this didn't work for me!

After putting it on for a few days (maybe 3). My skin next to my ears starting to breakout. Now anytime I put it on my skin turned hot and itchy like crazy. I love this brand and has other products from them with no issue. Not sure why my skin doesn't like this.

Gifted by Dermalogica. I tried this sunscreen today in hopes it would be a new addition to my rotation! I have very oily skin so I have trouble with SPF being too greasy sometimes. I felt like this settled into my skin well and didn't make me any more oily than I would usually be! It has a slight tint and blurs nicely. I will definitely keep using!

Dermalogica's matte spf was my all time favorite sunscreen and I was pretty upset when they discounted it. since then i've tried a wide range of mineral and chemical sunscreens. I have sensitive combo skin and prefer something light weight and non greasy, and this spf is it! feels a bit tacky at first but once it dries down you're left with a beautiful skin like finish. It also works great under foundation, and sometimes i even mix the two together to make my own tinted sunscreen. Overall this is a great facial spf that I'd recommend for anyone with combo/normal and even oily skin!

extraits.titre: no greasy residue or white cast
extraits.texte: I love this Porescreen SPF 40 gifted by Dermalogica. I always use dermalogica products but first time to try this Porescreen SPF 40. It applies effortlessly, leaving no greasy residue or white cast and makeup goes on with it. I have dry sensitive skin and this product doesn't cause breakouts or irritation. I recommended!

I love this sunscreen!! I live in Florida and have to use sunscreen everyday, this one has been amazing for my skin. I have extremely sensitive and acne prone skin and this spf doesn't break me out! Try it!! Gifted by dermalogica

Great sunscreen, super easy to apply, good protection, I've melasma and I can see it has well protected my skin. It didn't leave any white trace, and you can apply it before make up. I recommend it. Product was gifted to me by the brand for testing purposes.
